fact: The head of the National Authority for Remote Sensing said on 30 October 2025 that, with the agriculture ministry, it has estimated the areas of nine strategic crops from satellite imagery and AI models to give decision-makers expected production.
title: رئيس «الاستشعار عن بعد»: صور الأقمار الصناعية تحدد مساحات المحاصيل الاستراتيجية في مصر
